before.action: I put my initials beside the new clue on {prop}.
before.opening: Found it first. Write that down. {request}
before.response: You can catch up after I've tested the answer. {counter}
before.closing: My pencil was already numbering the together part.

after.action: I compare your new clue with the tracking entry beside {prop}.
after.opening: Tracking says reception. I've solved the whole building while you were still refreshing. {request}
after.response: One stayed downstairs, then. I've narrowed it to one desk. {counter}
after.challenge: The trolley's here. There's a box wedged underneath.
after.closing: So it left reception but never got unloaded. You've found the parcel; I've solved why we've been calling reception all morning.

before.action: I address the talking wall beside {prop} with practised nonchalance.
before.opening: Only a talking wall. How ordinary. {request}
before.response: Some of us have always spoken fluent brick. {counter}
before.closing: By how much fuss people make about an entirely routine impossibility.

after.action: I admire your ease with the talking doorway beside {prop}.
after.opening: You asked that doorway without hesitating. That's impressive. I usually just chat. {request}
after.challenge: Through its ear. Give me a minute; I've never gone in that way.
after.closing: Left ear or right, door? You take your minute. I'll save you a cubicle.
